origin.statement: Snake is authored source, not a Factory projection, so Factory's source-edition review state does not apply to it.

license.note: Decision D1: Snake v1 to v4 are MIT, decided under the owner's standing order to decide against the vision. The owner may revise D1 in the licence review.

publication.approval: they can get the snake game and progression ... I want everything really published to those places including the snake video progression and then the better than jevzra comparison

dependencies.note: plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript; tests use Node's built-in test runner; nothing is installed or bundled

gates: a sensitive-terms scan of the working tree, every reachable blob and every commit's author, committer, message and trailers, blocking 0, before the repository is made public
